projectDescription: A macOS menu bar app and CLI tool that reads USB-C port data via IOKit to tell you in plain English what each cable can do — speed, power, e-marker details, and charging diagnostics.
keyFeatures: Per-port plain-English cable diagnosis (Thunderbolt, USB4, USB 3.x, charge-only, slow cable)
Charging bottleneck identification (cable limit, charger limit, or Mac throttling)
Cable e-marker decoding: speed (up to 80 Gbps), current rating (up to 5A/240W), vendor
Full USB-PD charger PDO list with live negotiated profile highlighted
Connected device identity from PD Discover Identity VDOs
Active transport breakdown (USB 2, USB 3, Thunderbolt, DisplayPort)
Raw IOKit property inspector (⌥-click or Settings toggle)
CLI with text, JSON, and --watch streaming modes
Universal binary (Apple Silicon + Intel app shell), Apple-notarised
publicApiSurface: PortSummary — plain-English interpretation of a USBCPort
ChargingDiagnostic — bottleneck analysis (cableLimit, macLimit, fine, etc.)
PowerSource / PowerOption — PDO list and winning negotiated profile
PDIdentity / PDVDO — PD Discover Identity VDO decoder (CableVDO, IDHeader)
